title: Fan Favorites Rewind, Vol. 1
intro: [excited] Welcome back, Jeopardy fans! Tonight we're dusting off some all-time classic categories: wizards, farms, famous voices, and the coolest spots in the parks. [laughs] Let's rewind!

art.prompt: A retro game-show stage with a glowing blue board of 25 blank screens, golden spotlights, sparkling confetti, and a vintage VCR tape reel motif Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Wart and the Wizard
categories.intro: [excited] We kick off with a boy, a sword, and a wizard with a very long beard. [chuckles] Pull these answers out of your brain like a sword from a stone.

art.prompt: A lone sword plunged into a mossy anvil on a stone in a sunbeam-lit medieval churchyard, an old wizard's pointed blue hat and a stack of floating books nearby Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: At the start of The Sword in the Stone, young Arthur heads into the forest to fetch one of these that Kay shot.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is an arrow! He goes looking for an arrow and finds a wizard. Talk about a lucky trip to the woods.

clues.clue: After Arthur upsets him, Merlin blasts off on vacation to this sunny place, and the 20th century.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Bermuda! He comes back in shorts and sunglasses. Honestly, the man earned a vacation.

clues.clue: Merlin's magic lessons turn Arthur into these three animals, in this order.
clues.answer: A fish, a squirrel and a bird
accept: a fish, a squirrel and a bird
choices: A fish, a squirrel and a bird
A fish, a rabbit and an owl
A bird, a frog and a squirrel
A squirrel, a fish and a dog
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a fish, a squirrel and a bird! [sighs] And poor little girl squirrel never got over it. Merlin, you owe her a card.

clues.clue: Arthur's foster father, Sir Ector, keeps calling Merlin by this wrong name.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Marvin! Make yourself at home, Marvin. If I got a name that wrong, I'd turn into a fish too.

clues.clue: To win the Wizards' Duel, Merlin turns into this rare germ that gives Madam Mim spots and sniffles.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is malignalitaloptereosis! Try saying that three times fast. [whispers] I can't even say it once.

categories.title: Old MacDisney Had a Farm
categories.intro: Grab your overalls! Every clue in this one is about farms, farmers, and ranch hands in the Disney universe. [laughs] E-I-E-I-oh no.

art.prompt: A cheerful red barn at sunrise surrounded by golden hay bales, a tractor, a windmill, and fields of glowing green crops under a pastel sky Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This rusty, buck-toothed tow truck from Cars loves sneaking out at night to go tractor tipping.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Mater! He's the world's best backwards driver and the world's worst at keeping quiet near sleeping tractors.

clues.clue: Three dairy cows try to save the Patch of Heaven farm in this 2004 film, with songs by Alan Menken.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Home on the Range! [chuckles] It's the Disney movie everybody forgets, which makes it perfect for a game show.

clues.clue: Butch, Nash and Ramsey are T. rex ranchers herding longhorns in this Pixar film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Good Dinosaur! Dinosaur cowboys. Somebody at Pixar had a really great Tuesday.

clues.clue: He doesn't own a single cow, but this man has been the voice of Goofy since 1987, and his last name is a farm job.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Bill Farmer! Gawrsh. He's been Goofy for over three decades, and his name is the best part of this category.

clues.clue: In Strange World, Searcher Clade farms this glowing green plant that powers the land of Avalonia.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pando! And spoiler alert, farming it turns out to be a really bad idea for a very big turtle.

categories.title: Lend Me Your Ears
categories.intro: Listen up! I'll play you a line from a Disney or Pixar film. You tell me which character said it. [whispers] Ears on, folks.

art.prompt: A vintage golden gramophone horn blooming with glowing musical notes and swirling sound waves over a red velvet theater stage Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Name the character who says this famous line.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear! Falling with style since 1995.

clues.clue: Name the warm-hearted character who says this line.
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Olaf! The only snowman who would happily melt for a friend. Somebody get him a fan.
clues.quote: Some people are worth melting for.

clues.clue: Name the little girl who teaches her alien pet this line.
clues.reveal: [chuckles] The correct answer is Lilo! Ohana means family, and family means even a blue alien gets a hug.
clues.quote: Ohana means family. Family means nobody gets left behind.

clues.clue: Name the skeleton who says this line to his songwriting partner.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Hector! And his partner Ernesto did not take it well. At all. Poison is not a breakup strategy.
clues.quote: I'm going home, Ernesto. Hate me if you want.

clues.clue: Name the chubby caterpillar from A Bug's Life who finally gets his wish with this line.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Heimlich! His wings are about the size of a postage stamp, but hey, a dream is a dream.

categories.title: Beat the Heat
categories.intro: Florida summers are no joke. [laughs] I'll show you a photo of a place in the parks where you can cool off. You name the place.

art.prompt: A sparkling turquoise wave pool under palm trees with a beached shipwreck on a mountaintop, splash fountains and beach umbrellas in bright sun Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This water park's giant surf pool sits below a shrimp boat stuck on top of Mount Mayday. Name the water park.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Typhoon Lagoon! The boat is Miss Tilly, and she blows water every half hour. [laughs] Rude, but refreshing.

source.author: elisfkc from Orlando, FL, United States

clues.clue: This air-conditioned EPCOT pavilion is home to Soarin' and Living with the Land. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Land! Grab a seat at the Garden Grill, which slowly rotates while you eat. [chuckles] Dinner and a ride.

clues.clue: Sit in the first rows of this Hollywood Studios amphitheater and you may get splashed during this nighttime show.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Fantasmic! The Hollywood Hills Amphitheater is not in Hollywood, but the dragon definitely is on fire.

clues.clue: This shady Animal Kingdom theater hosted Tarzan Rocks! before Finding Nemo: The Musical arrived in 2007. Name the venue.
choices: Festival of the Lion King Theater
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Theater in the Wild! Swim on over and enjoy some air conditioning with your fish.

clues.clue: This often-forgotten EPCOT building between Test Track and Mexico is a cool spot for events and festivals. Name it.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is the Odyssey Pavilion! It opened in 1982 as a restaurant, and these days it's EPCOT's best-kept indoor secret.

categories.title: Extreme Close-Up
categories.intro: Our fans love a zoom! I'll show you a very, very close look at a famous Disney object. Name the film it comes from.

art.prompt: A giant antique magnifying glass hovering over a treasure table of tiny glowing magical props, sparkles and bokeh lights Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Zoom in on this sparkly object. Which film does it belong to?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella! One glass slipper, left behind at midnight. Worst lost-and-found case in history.

media.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of a sparkling glass slipper resting on a blue velvet pillow, glittering facets catching candlelight Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This enchanted object is losing its petals. Name the film.
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beauty and the Beast! When that last petal falls, it's game over. [whispers] No pressure.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a single glowing red rose floating under a glass bell jar, a few fallen petals on a dark wooden table Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This glowing green stone has a spiral carved in it. Name the film.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Moana! It's the heart of Te Fiti, and you're welcome. [laughs] Sorry, wrong demigod.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a smooth glowing green pounamu stone with a spiral carved into it, resting on dark ocean sand with sparkling water Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Two golden halves of this beetle fit together to find a famous cave. Name the film.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Aladdin! The golden scarab leads to the Cave of Wonders. Touch nothing but the lamp!

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a golden scarab beetle amulet split into two halves with glowing red eyes, desert sand blowing past at night Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This glowing blue gem has been broken into pieces. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Raya and the Last Dragon! The Dragon Gem broke into five pieces, and everyone fought over them. [sighs] Classic group project.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up of a glowing blue crystal orb shattered into five sharp shards, swirling mist and ancient carved stone in the background Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.
